preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.
For each test case, the number of provinces N is between 2 and 200,000 inclusive.
The number of destroyed roads M is non-negative and bounded by the total possible edges or 300,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= N and 1 <= v <= N and u != v for u, v in destroyed_edges)
preconditions.description: All destroyed road endpoints are valid distinct province indices within the range [1, N].
All destroyed edges listed in the input are unique.
The sum of N and the sum of M across all test cases do not exceed 200,000 and 500,000 respectively.

postconditions.description: The output consists of exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(line, str) and line.strip().isdigit() for line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line contains a non-negative integer representing the count of valid configurations.

postconditions.expression: count == sum(1 for X_set in valid_X_partitions if is_valid_config(X_set, N, destroyed_edges))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output count equals the number of valid partitions of provinces into sets X and Y satisfying: (1) X and Y are non-empty and disjoint with union equal to all provinces; (2) No two provinces in X are connected by an existing road (i.e., for all u, v in X, the edge (u, v) is in destroyed_edges); (3) For every province p in X, every province q in Y is adjacent to p in the remaining graph (i.e., for all p in X and q in Y, the edge (p, q) is NOT in destroyed_edges).
